en.tagline: Try, compare, and refine your vision.
en.prompt_example: A quiet garden in morning light, with soft watercolor colors.
en.source_hint: Select an image to edit it with your prompt. You can also use an image from your history.
en.random_hint: leave blank for a random seed
en.seed_hint: Keep the seed and settings fixed to compare prompts. Results may vary across environments.
en.loading_hint: The first run takes extra time to load the model.
en.empty_hint: Generate an image from a prompt, or choose an image to get started. Images and settings stay on this computer.
en.submitted: Generation queued. Follow its progress in your history.
en.reused: Settings restored. Adjust the prompt and generate again.
en.editing: Selected this image as the source. Seed reset to random to avoid reusing the source image’s initial noise. Enter your editing instructions.
en.notes_hint: Observations and ideas for the next attempt
en.error_string: {field}: use a string of at most 12000 characters.
en.error_dimensions: Width and height must be multiples of 32.
en.error_queue: Too many pending jobs. Wait for a job to finish.
en.error_interrupted: The previous run was interrupted. Reuse its settings to try again.
en.error_origin: Perform this action from the app on the same origin.
en.error_notes: Notes must be a string of at most 4000 characters.
en.error_pixels: Images must contain no more than 20 million pixels.
en.error_numeric: Image conversion failed. Restart with --dtype bfloat16 or --dtype float32.
en.error_bad_request: Invalid request. Check the input and try again.
en.error_too_large: The upload exceeds the 20 MB limit.
en.error_method: This request method is not supported.
en.batch_hint: Generate 1–8 variations sequentially with different seeds. Compare results, then choose “Edit this image” to continue.
en.error_page: Use a positive integer page and favorites=0 or 1.
en.error_storage_limit: Storage limit reached. Increase --max-storage-gb or free managed storage before trying again.
en.error_disk_space: Not enough free disk space. Free disk space before trying again.
en.error_record_limit: History and upload limit reached. Increase --max-records before trying again.
en.error_rate_limit: Too many write requests. Wait one minute before trying again.
en.error_upload_busy: Two uploads are already being processed. Try again shortly.
en.delete_confirm: Permanently delete image {id}, its settings and notes? This cannot be undone. Images referenced by another history entry cannot be deleted.
en.deleted: Deleted the image and history entry.
en.error_delete_active: Wait until generation or cancellation finishes before deleting.
en.error_delete_referenced: Another history entry uses this image as its source. Delete those entries first.
en.error_delete_failed: Deletion failed. The history was kept. Check file permissions and free disk space.
en.error_delete_cleanup: The history was removed, but a temporary file could not be deleted. Restart the app after checking file permissions to finish cleanup.
en.cleanup_confirm: Permanently delete uploaded images that no history entry uses? The currently selected source is kept. This cannot be undone.
en.reset_hint: Keep the prompt and source image; reset size, steps, CFG, seed, image count and negative prompt.
